decision.reason: Full ladder, ESS, analytic conditional/compression checks, representation, genuine excursions and deep comparison pass

design.collection: full frozen physical cap for both arms; equal per-walker top quota; no padding or retry

case_precedence: D: incomplete ladder due to visit quota or ESS failure
B: sufficient samples fail any conditional distribution or compression truth check
C: conditional/compression pass but modal movement/representation/material improvement criteria fail
A: all full-ladder, numerical, representation, movement and material improvement criteria pass
criteria.conditional_checks: pooled KS/CDF, mean, second moment, mode fractions and exact membership at every generating contour; descriptive correlated-sample tolerances, not IID p-values
criteria.material_improvement: at every deep generating level and bank: diffusive collected-top mode switches >= max(10,2*baseline+5); each has >=5 witnessed connected-lower cross-mode returns

design.exchange_rule: disabled identity for all pairs and both arms; no cross-bank interactions
design.log_weight_rule: zero for every already-calibrated level, frozen before attempt

restart.process_check: parent Popen launch receipt, child PID/PPID and independent process-start UUID, timestamp and command

design.thinning: none: retain first 2048 post-burn assigned-top observations per walker, including self-loops
